name: Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W

outline.source: Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W mechanical drawing (Raspberry Pi Ltd): 65 x 30 mm; the 3.0 mm corner radius is not dimensioned on the drawing (value used by published case designs)

pcb.source: typical FR4 board thickness; not dimensioned on the mechanical drawing

mounting_holes.source: Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W mechanical drawing (Raspberry Pi Ltd): 3.5 mm from the edges, 58 x 23 mm pattern as drawn; hole 2.75 and pad 6.0 are not dimensioned there (standard Raspberry Pi M2.5 footprint)

connectors.name: mini-HDMI
connectors.source: port centre x = 12.4 mm as drawn; shell about 11 x 3.4 mm
connectors.note: centre from the drawing, shell size approximate

connectors.name: micro-USB data (OTG)
connectors.source: port centre x = 41.4 mm as drawn; body size from the receptacle datasheet
connectors.note: centre from the drawing, body size approximate

connectors.name: micro-USB power input
connectors.source: port centre x = 54.0 mm as drawn; body size from the receptacle datasheet
connectors.note: centre from the drawing, body size approximate

connectors.name: microSD card slot
connectors.source: socket at the short edge, outline read off the drawing (about 12 x 12 mm); card protrudes slightly
connectors.note: slot position and height are approximate; verify before cutting

connectors.name: 40-pin GPIO header (optional)
connectors.source: 2 x 20 pads on a 2.54 mm pitch along the top hole row (y = 26.5 mm); a soldered header is 8.5 mm tall
connectors.note: present only when a header is soldered (the 'WH' variant); kept as a conservative lid keepout

omitted: CSI camera connector (internal, no wall opening)
solder pads and test points on the underside
